contract: Existing scoped AVC/AAC TS input, complete remux bytes equal independently decoded prior exact-output oracle. Nonisolated JSPI execution; no MP4 priming claim.
workload: 228608-byte 4.021333-second fixture. Compare full acquisition then resident reads with HTTP byte ranges, both using same actual JSPI FFmpeg remux, fresh worker and engine. Every HTTP fixture request has15ms injected latency.
sampling: Seven paired trials alternating order; cold worker/module initialization every trial, same browser HTTP cache state; no discarded warmups.
threshold: Every exact-output and cleanup control must pass. Practicality for this tiny scoped fixture requires worst observed complete remux below source duration4021.333ms. This is a declared component throughput bound, not evidence JSPI is faster than pthreads. Compare observed overhead and report all raw pairs.
limits: Shared host load; no matched pthread build benchmark, physical memory RSS, player integration or energy claim. Input acquisition, range transfer, startup, output transfer, close and termination included. Resident mode retains full source; range mode does not retain previous reads in JS. Browser cache/OS may retain source separately.
